questions.stem: ------- economic growth rates have stagnated over the last 6 months, we cannot expect any rise in the value of the dollar.
It seems certain ------- our industry will be faced with multiple challenges in the near and medium term, principally because of changes in the international political landscape.
questions.translation: 看起来我们的工业在中短期内将面临多重挑战，这其中最主要的原因在于国际政治局势的转变。
questions.explanation: 横线后已构成完整的结构，句首的it指代的并不是特定的名词或名词短语，而是后面的句子，作形式主语，句子结构应为It seems certain + that 从句。引导名词性从句的连词 (B) that正确。

questions.stem: One of the city’s landmark department stores has filed for bankruptcy; however there is no indication that the historic building ------- will be demolished or redeveloped.
questions.translation: 这个城市的一个地标性百货公司已经申请破产；尽管如此，没有迹象表明这栋有历史意义的建筑将被拆除或重建。
questions.explanation: 横线位于主语the historic building和谓语will be demolished...之间，最恰当的是反身代词 (D) itself。强调主语实施的动作或主语实施的动作影响到自身时，用反身代词。

questions.stem: Mitusa Motors today announced that its headquarters ------- to the port city of Kumamoto in order to take advantage of cheaper transportation costs.
questions.translation: 米突萨汽车公司今天宣布将总部迁到港口城市熊本，以利用更低廉的运输成本。
questions.explanation: 横线后有地点状语to the port city of Kumamoto (往港口城市熊本)，而且its headquarters是relocate的宾语，因此横线处需填入 relocate (搬迁，迁移) 的被动语态。故选 (D) will be relocated。

questions.stem: Any reports produced by this department should be edited and proofread ------ - by someone other than the writer.
questions.translation: 这个部门作出的任何报告都应该由作者以外的人彻底修订和校对。
questions.explanation: 本题需选择适当词义的副词。与should be edited and proofread (应该修订和校对) 语意最连贯的是 (D) thoroughly (彻底地，详尽地) 。

questions.stem: The minerals boom has brought about an economic boom, which in turn has meant that real estate values have ------- to record levels.
questions.translation: 矿业繁荣带来了经济繁荣，这转而意味着房地产行业已经上升到创纪录的水平。
questions.explanation: 本题需正确区分及物动词raise和不及物动词rise。to record levels (创纪录的水平) 并非宾语，而是表示程度的状语，因此横

questions.stem: In response to our question on overall customer satisfaction, 23% of respondents indicated that they were somewhat or very -------.
questions.translation: 在回答我们关于整体客户满意度的问题时，23%的受访者表明他们有些或非常不满意。
questions.explanation: 本题考查分词 (现在分词或过去分词) 作表语。分词作表语时，如果主语与表语为被动关系，用过去分词；如果是主动关系，则用现在分词。they (=23% of respondents) 和dissatisfy (使不满；使不服) 是被动关系，故选 (B) dissatisfied。

questions.stem: A new strategic plan ------- increasing productivity was introduced at the last meeting of the board of directors.
questions.translation: 上次董事会会议上介绍了一个旨在提高生产力的新战略计划。
questions.explanation: 本题需选择适当的介词。increasing productivity (提高生产力) 是strategic plan (战略计划) 的目的，因此选择表示目的的介词 (C) for。

questions.stem: Employees at the Maroubra plant were ------- that operations would cease in approximately 6 months and that generous retirement packages would be given to all employees.
questions.translation: 马鲁巴工厂的员工接到通知，工厂将在约6个月后停止经营并且会发给每位员工丰厚的退休金。
questions.explanation: 本句是由inform A that B句型转换成被动语态的句子。答案是 (B) informed。

questions.stem: The president ------- his difficult childhood with giving him the strength of character needed to succeed in a fiercely competitive environment.
questions.translation: 总统认为他艰苦的童年给了他在激烈的竞争环境中取胜所需的坚强性格。
questions.explanation: 备选答案中的动词都可用于“动词+ A with B”的结构，因此需要一一代入后分析全句，选择最符合句意的动词。最恰当的是credit A with B (把B归功于A) 。provide A with B (给A提供B)，reward A with B (以B报答A)，present A with B (给A赠送B) 都不符合句意。

questions.stem: ------- any surprise submissions this afternoon, the court case should be wrapped up today after 2 years of bitter wrangling.
When operating in a new culture, it is very important to be ------- of local practices which, at first sight, may seem strange.
questions.translation: 在新文化中经营时，尊重当地习俗很重要，尽管这些习俗乍一看可能很奇怪。
questions.explanation: 横线处所填单词作be的表语，因此排除动词 (A) respect和副词 (D) respectively。句意应为“尊重当地习俗很重要，尽管这些习俗乍一看可能很奇怪”，故选 (B) respectful (尊重的)。(C) respective表示“各自的，分别的”。

questions.stem: The report by Absolute Consultants advised that at least ------- year will be required before the company can attain profitability.
questions.translation: 独立顾问公司的报告表明公司实现盈利至少还需要一年。
questions.explanation: 横线处需填入修饰单数名词year的限定词。答案是 (C) another。another 后接名词单数，other后接名词复数。

questions.stem: ------- that it is undesirable to treat our production line workers like robots, we have introduced a policy of frequent job rotations.
The Personnel Department has lost no time seeking a ------- for Dr. Roberts, who recently retired after 30 years of service.
questions.translation: 人力资源部一直在抓紧时间寻找罗伯茨博士的接班人，他已工作了30 年，最近刚退休。
questions.explanation: “罗伯茨博士的接班人”的句意最恰当，故选 (B) replacement (后任；代替，替换)。replacement for sb. 表示“某人的接班人”，find / look for/ seek a replacement for... 表示“寻找…的接班人”。

questions.stem: Any employee wishing to terminate his or her employment before the end of the contract may do so after giving 30 days written -------.
questions.translation: 任何想要在合同期满之前终止雇佣关系的员工可以提前30天提交书面通知。
questions.explanation: 在合同到期前辞去工作时，需要事先提交辞职信之类的书面通知。答案是 (C) notice (通知) 。

questions.stem: The task of the high-profile planning committee will be to ------- the Asian Games organizers to choose our city as the site of the next games.
questions.translation: 计划委员会备受瞩目的任务是说服亚运会组织者选择我市作为下一届运动会的举办地。
questions.explanation: ______ the Asian Games organizers to choose our city as the site of the next games是“动词+宾语+不定式”的结构。只有 (A) convince符合。convince sb. to do表示“说服某人做某事”。

questions.stem: Government regulations state that no one can be ------- to the closed reading room without first obtaining a security clearance.
questions.translation: 政府法规规定，没有进行安全审查之前不能进入这间不对外开放的阅览室。
questions.explanation: 根据no one can be，to the closed reading room， without first obtaining a security clearance等内容，应选 (C) admitted。

questions.stem: There can be no doubt that our Marketing Department has grown ------- confidence and ability with each new success.
questions.translation: 毫无疑问，随着每一次新成功，我们市场部的信心和能力都得到了提高。
questions.explanation: 提高的具体范围是confidence and ability，故选表示特定范围的介词 (A) in。

questions.stem: The catering unit ------- that all patrons complete the questionnaire so that we can provide the best possible service at the most reasonable cost.
questions.translation: 餐饮单位请求所有的顾客完成调查问卷，以便我们以最合理的成本提供尽可能最优质的服务。
questions.explanation: 本题需选择符合句意的动词。that引导的从句内容为“所有的顾客完成调查问卷”，so that后接的是意为“以便我们能以最合理的成本提供尽可能最优质的服务”的目的状语从句，横线处需填入向顾客提出请求的动词。答案是 (C) requests。

questions.stem: New procedures for the operation of the security system will ------- to ensure that there are no more delays in accessing the building on weekends.
questions.translation: 将引入安全系统的新操作程序，以确保周末能顺利出入大厦。
questions.explanation: will后接动词原形，因主语new procedures与introduce之间是被动关系，故选被动语态 (D) be introduced。

questions.stem: ------- application procedures have resulted in a drop in interest in our investment and other financial services packages.
Customers need to consider carefully ------- kind of interior fittings will best satisfy both their needs and tastes.
questions.translation: 顾客需要仔细考虑哪种室内装修最满足他们的需求和品味。
questions.explanation: 横线处所填单词修饰名词kind，且横线后应构成名词性从句。答案是 (A) which。

questions.stem: Before adding new stocks ------- your investment portfolio, why not attend one of our investment seminars, where you will be able to meet our consultants in a small group setting?
questions.translation: 在把新股票列入您的投资组合中前，为什么不参加我们的投资讲座呢？您将能在小班中见到我们的顾问。
questions.explanation: 本题需选择适当的介词。根据句意，应取add A to B (把A加到B) 的结构，故选 (B) to。

questions.stem: Mining operations at the southwestern mine have been ------- until the question of ownership has been resolved by the courts.
questions.translation: 西南矿井的采矿作业已经被停止，直到法院解决所有权问题才可重新开工。
questions.explanation: 根据状语从句until the question of ownership has been resolved by the courts (直到法院解决所有权问题为止)，最恰当的是 (A) halted。

questions.stem: All employees are reminded that there is much satisfaction to be gained from - ------ the community in some voluntary capacity.
questions.translation: 所有员工被提醒在某些志愿者工作中，为社区服务能获得很高的满意度。
questions.explanation: 横线处需要填入被in some voluntary capacity修饰、以the community为宾语的动词，符合句意的是 (A) serving。

questions.stem: ------- planning requires practical knowledge, attention to detail, an ability to listen to all stake-holders, and flexibility.
The purpose of this planning meeting is to ensure that our move to the new site will not cause any ------- in our services.
questions.translation: 这次规划会议的目的就是确保公司搬迁新址不会引起我们服务的中断。
questions.explanation: 本题需选择符合句意的名词。因our move to the new site (搬迁新址)，可能会发生“服务的中断”。答案是 (D) interruption (中断；干扰) 。

questions.stem: The CEO of Griffin Investments said today that he had absolutely no hesitation in ------- that his company had always operated within strict, ethical guidelines.
questions.translation: 格里芬投资公司的首席执行官今天毫不犹豫地肯定公司一直都在执行严格的道德指导方针。
questions.explanation: 本题需选择符合句意的动词。以that his company had always operated within strict, ethical guidelines (他的公司一直都在执行严格的道德指导方针) 为宾语，与he had absolutely no hesitation in (他毫不犹豫地…) 语意连贯的是 (A) affirming (肯定) 。

questions.stem: ------- for any reason you are unable to attend tomorrow’s meeting, please notify Ms. Clifton as soon as possible so that the catering arrangements can be modified.

passages.title: Halls will Come to Life with Music
passages.text: Halls will Come to Life with Music Albert Hall and Royal Hall have disclosed their schedules for the upcoming season, with everything (131) -------- classical music to stand-up comedy acts and lots in between. (132) --------. The venerable venue (133) -------- will host Bruce Thornton on January 17, Ron Ghanem on January 3, Terry Lightfoot on January 9, and folk superstar Judith Bachman on February 12, 13, and 14. At Royal Hall, in its classical (134) --------, American soprano Rosemary Voigt, Canadian soprano Jonathon Pierre, Canadian baritone Mel Finley, and Polish contralto George Podles are on the bill.

questions.explanation: classical music to stand-up comedy acts and lots in between 是演出内容，classical music和stand-up comedy acts是不同种类的艺术形式。按照句意，应该使用表示范围的from... to... (从…到…)。答案是 (D)。

options.A: American Soprano Rosemary Voigt is very popular among people all over the world.
options.B: The Smiths are set to make their debut at 100-year-old Albert Hall.
options.C: Albert Hall and Royal Hall both have great seating capacity. 969
options.D: The folk superstar Judith Bachman is more famous than the Canadian baritone Mel Finley.

questions.explanation: 下句说“这个庄严肃穆的音乐厅也将于……举办……”。可知，横线处句子应该描述音乐厅的演出信息，故选 (B)。
前一句提到史密斯一家将在阿尔伯特音乐厅首次登台，之后又介绍了几位艺术家的演出安排，故最恰当的是 (C) also。
横线后列举了女高音歌唱家、男中音歌唱家、女低音歌唱家的名字，因此 (A) series (系列) 最恰当。

passages.title: Thornhill Sales
passages.text: Thornhill Sales Increased 124% in June Trimart’s Housing Report gave Thornhill the number one ranking in sales for the month of June. Sales in Thornhill increased by 124%, with 330 sales (135) -------- to a May tally of 147. This dramatic (136) -------- was the result of the outstanding success of the Saxton Group’s launch of their new, affordable subdivision Home Sweet Home. In its first weekend, Home Sweet Home completely sold out its 152-unit inventory in the Thornhill area. A more (137) -------- increase of 16% was recorded in the Toronto region, comprised of North York, East York, Etobicoke, York, and Central Toronto. (138) --------.

questions.explanation: 按照句意，横线处所填单词应表示“与…比较”，答案是 (B) compared。compared to是表示“与…比较，与…相比”的常用词组。
本句主要是在说明销售量增长的原因，因此最恰当的是 (D) increase (增加，增长)。
横线处需填入与increase语意连贯的形容词。答案是 (C) moderate (稳健的，适度的)。

options.A: Home Sweet Home has only 200-unit inventory in the Thornhill area.
options.B: It just took two weeks for Thornhill to completely sell out its inventory.
options.C: More than 100 sales were realized in Thornhill in May and July.
options.D: The total market area experienced a 5% increase in sales over May.

questions.explanation: 围绕“翠马特的住房报告”，文章第一、二段分别详述销售量增长的结果及原因。横线处句子应描述整个市场住房销售量的情况才与原文意思连贯，故选 (D)。

passages.title: Dreamaker
passages.text: Dreamaker The professionals that make your nights comfortable The Dreamaker Plus (139) -------- the exclusive coil system everyone’s been talking about. For the past 50 years, the experts at Dreamaker have dedicated their time and effort to bring the Americans a good night’s rest by using our reliable and (140) -------- technology. Compared to any conventional spring systems available in the industry, the Dreamaker Plus has nearly twice the coils of any others. (141) --------. By increasing the wire thickness in the outer two rows, Dreamaker Plus (142) -------- a firmer seating edge, increases the useable sleeping space, and helps to prevent that“roll out of bed” feeling.

questions.explanation: The Dreamaker Plus是产品名，the exclusive coil system是产品特点。最符合句意的是动词features (以…为特色)，故选 (B)。
并列连词and前后词性应保持一致。可知，横线处应填形容词，故选 (B) proven (经过证实的)。

options.A: Experts at the Dreamaker have spent less than 50 years studying the coil system.
options.B: The exclusive coil system of the Dreamaker Plus is very popular among Americans.
options.C: Quality comfort layers and fabrics have been used to ensure a comfortable and durable sleeping surface.
options.D: The number of coils does a great matter in making comfortable beds.

questions.explanation: 本文介绍造梦者Plus为美国人带来舒适睡眠的方法。上句介绍其螺旋弹簧系统的独特之处。可知，横线处应该继续介绍这种床垫材质好在哪里，故选 (C)。
横线处需填入动词，因主语是第三人称单数，故选 (D) provides。

passages.title: Michelle L. Sinnott
passages.text: Michelle L. Sinnott The Mitel Limited 45 Landsdowne Road Seattle, Washington Dear Ms. Sinnott: Mr. Steven Davis, who is currently employed as a junior accountant at your firm, has recently shown his interest in a similar post with (143) -------- and has provided your name as a reference. (144) --------. Furthermore, if you can provide your personal views of how his (145) -------- with you have been and what your opinion is regarding Mr. Davis taking on full responsibility as an accountant in a very large and busy department, I would appreciate it. I am (146) -------- aware that Mr. Davis graduated from George Brown College with an accounting degree but I am more interested in how he has performed under your supervision since he began working for you. If there is any other information you feel I can use, I would appreciate it very much. I’d like to thank you in advance and add that any information you provide will be treated as strictly confidential. Sincerely, Brian S. Simpson Accounting Manager Coram Incorporated (206) 755 8956

questions.explanation: 句意应为“贵公司的初级会计师史蒂文·戴维斯最近对我们公司的一个类似职位表示很感兴趣…”。答案是 (B) us。

options.A: I would be grateful to receive any information regarding his work achievements.
options.B: It seems that Mr. Steven Davis has abundant work experience.
options.C: I’m satisfied with Mr. Steven Davis’s work ethic, character and achievements.
options.D: All information about Mr. Steven Davis is treated as confidential.

questions.explanation: 下句写信人询问有关史蒂文·戴维斯的工作情况。由Furthermore可知，横线处也是询问他的工作业绩，故选 (A)。
给辛诺特写信是为了深入了解史蒂文·戴维斯，因此句意要表达“有关他在贵公司的工作表现，如果您能提供一些个人意见…”。答案是 (C) services。
(A) enough修饰形容词或副词时一般位于其后，可排除；常与aware 搭配使用的副词是 (D) fully (充分地，完全地)。

passages.title: Mandy Jenkins [11:50 A.M.]
passages.text: Mandy Jenkins [11:50 A.M.] Hello, Tyrell. Have you reviewed the letter I e-mailed you earlier? Tyrell Smith [11:51 A.M.] I checked it out, but you need to make several changes. Mr. Aaron altered the terms of the contract we’re offering Ms. Evans. Mandy Jenkins [11:52 A.M.] I wasn’t aware of that. Should I drop by your office now to discuss the matter? Tyrell Smith [11:53 A.M.] I’ve got a lunch meeting with a client. Why don’t you come here at 3:00? Mandy Jenkins [11:55 A.M.] Okay. That should be enough time to edit the document and to arrive at the post office before it closes.

questions.stem: At 11:53 A.M., what does Mr. Smith mean when he writes,“I’ve got a lunch meeting with a client”?

options.A: He cannot meet Ms. Jenkins now.
options.C: He will be absent from work all day.
options.D: He wants Ms. Jenkins to go with him.

questions.translation: 上午11点53分，史密斯先生写道“我和一位客户有一个午餐会议”，他是什么意思？ (A) 他现在不能会见詹金斯女士。 (B) 他刚离开办公室。 (C) 他一整天都不会在公司。 (D) 他想让詹金斯女士和他一起去。
questions.explanation: 詹金斯女士询问她现在能否到史密斯先生的办公室去讨论问题，史密斯先生回复说他和一位客户有一个午餐会议，并建议詹金斯女士3点再来，意思就是目前他没有时间，不能和詹金斯女士见面。答案是 (A)。

questions.stem: What does Ms. Jenkins suggest about the letter?

options.B: Mr. Smith has to sign it.
options.D: It needs to be mailed today.

questions.translation: 对于这封信件，詹金斯女士暗示了什么？ (A) 她已经把它打印出来了。 (B) 史密斯先生必须签字。 (C) 客户要求专人递送。 (D) 今天需要邮寄出去。
questions.explanation: 史密斯先生告诉詹金斯女士，信件内容有几处需要修改，并建议了见面讨论的时间。詹金斯女士回复说要编辑文件，还要在邮局下班之前赶到那里，时间应该够用。由此可知，这封信件修改之后需要打印出来，今天就得邮寄出去。答案是 (D)。

passages.title: Date: January 22
passages.text: Date: January 22 To: Mary Moore From: Rupert Baker Re: Suggested schedule for French Spring Dinnerware ad campaign This is one of our biggest projects so far, so let’s get busy. Here is my suggested timeline. As you can see, our first meeting with the clients is next Monday, and the final portfolio must be finished and approved by the client no later than March 1. What do you think? Please get back to me today. You have my email address. My cell phone number is 224-0099.

questions.stem: Why did Mr. Baker leave the message?

options.A: To ask for some assistance with the project
options.B: To receive feedback on a proposal
options.D: To make an appointment for a meeting

questions.translation: 为什么贝克先生要留这个信息？ (A) 为这个项目寻求一些帮助 (B) 为了得到某个提案的反馈 (C) 为了赢得一个新项目 (D) 为了约定会议时间
questions.explanation: 这是针对餐具类广告的提案，旨在寻求对方意见。答案是 (B)。

questions.stem: When will the staff meet to assess and produce new ideas for the work?
questions.translation: 员工什么时候开会评估这个项目并提供新想法？ (A) 1月25日，周一 (B) 1月26日，周二 (C) 1月30日，周六 (D) 2月8日，周一
questions.explanation: 星期二的日程内容为have a brainstorming session，故答案是 (B)。brainstorming意为“集体讨论”。

questions.stem: What will Ms. Moore do after she reads the message?

options.A: Submit the work she has done to Mr. Moore
options.B: Give a presentation to the client
options.C: Suggest her opinions on the timetable she received
options.D: Get in touch with French Spring’s marketing people

questions.translation: 穆尔女士读完这个信息会做什么？ (A) 把她做好的工作交给见克先生 (B) 给客户作报告 (C) 对她收到的时间表提出建议 (D) 和法国春天市场部的人员取得联系
questions.explanation: 穆尔女士需要将本人意见反馈给贝克先生。答案是 (C)。

passages.title: New York (April 14) – The famous New York institution, the
passages.text: New York (April 14) – The famous New York institution, the Winchester Hotel, established in 1887, has just announced its intention to enter the convention market. In a press release today, the hotel’s management announced that it will demolish several adjacent buildings, which it also owns, to make way for a new convention center to be known as the Winchester Center. The design, already approved by the New York City Council, involves ultra-modern facilities that will be linked to the existing hotel by an atrium. passages.text: MOVIES Ratings out of 5 IN THE MINOTAUR’S MAZE This movie belongs to a completely new genre perhaps. It’s a historical horror movie set in ancient Greece, thousands of years ago. Filmed on location in beautiful Crete, it features beautiful young people from all over Greece being shipped as sacrifices to the Minotaur. The contrast between the sparkling light of the Greek islands and the darkness of the mysterious Minotaur’s maze is stunningly done. A gripping and visually impressive movie. ••• 1/2 Ben King SWEAT AND BLOOD This Spanish nonfiction movie set during the Civil War deservedly won the critics’ prize at last year’s Toronto Film Festival. Filmed in a naturalistic style, it follows the lives of 4 once-close friends who are separated by the war. Realistic and dramatic, it paints an all-too-believable picture of a world turned upside- down by war. Recommended. (English subtitles) •••• Jane Stevenson YOUNG HEARTS IN VENICE This is an awful attempt at a“romantic drama.” Young Hearts in Venice tries to exploit the Venetian setting to give this very ordinary little story a lift but utterly fails. Two couples intent on a romantic Venetian holiday accidentally meet. They spend time together and… you guessed it: there are unexpected chemical reactions. The problem is that the script and acting are so poor that we couldn’t care less about any of the protagonists! Not recommended. • M.H. RED RAIN If you enjoy horror movies where city slickers unintentionally get stuck in sinister country towns, this movie is for you. Red Rain is a finely crafted effort from one of the masters of schlock-horror, Jim Middleton. There’s nothing new in the plot, but the special effects, décor, and script are excellent, and the acting, mostly by unknowns, is also first-rate. ••• 1/2 Jane Stevenson

passages.title: The Fredericksburg Spring Festival
passages.text: The Fredericksburg Spring Festival It’s time once again for the biggest event of the year in Fredericksburg. This year, the festival will take place from May 1 to 5. Due to the recent increase in attendees, the festival is being moved to Pine Tree Park. Some of this year’s events will include flower displays, athletic contests, sporting events, arts and crafts, an auction, a petting zoo, and a daily parade and fireworks show. There will be numerous concerts by local performers, and the world-famous band Peter and the Gang will be there, too. Tickets are $3 per day or $10 for all five days of the event. Call 584-9373 for more information regarding the schedule, tickets, and parking. Fredericksburg Spring Festival Concert Schedule May 1 This schedule is subject to change. In case of rain, concerts will be moved to the Fredericksburg Community Center, located across the street from Pine Tree Park. May 7 Dear Tina, I just got back home to Dayton. I really appreciating your inviting me to the spring festival in your town this year. I had such a great time. I thought I would be bored going to the festival every single day, but my initial thoughts were incorrect. Instead, there was something different for us to do on every day of the event. I really loved watching Greg Powers perform in the community center on the first day of the festival. That’s something I won’t ever forget. I hope to be able to attend next year’s festival as well. I’m sure it will be just as good as this year’s. Regards, Susan

passages.title: Crompton Semiconductors Coming to City
passages.text: Crompton Semiconductors Coming to City Feldberg (August 9) – Global semiconductor giant Crompton, Inc. will open its newest facility in Feldberg next March. On August 8, a Crompton spokesperson announced that management had selected Feldberg from among eight potential sites. The spokesperson commented on several reasons Feldberg was selected. Most notable among them was the fact that Feldberg is constructing an area called Hathaway Business Park on the city’s eastern edges. It will be completed in December of this year, and several companies have already committed to opening offices and other facilities there. In addition, the highly educated workforce in the city was singled out for being an attractive feature. The low cost of living and pleasant climate were also mentioned. http://www.cromptonsemiconductors.com Crompton, Inc. is opening a research facility in the city of Feldberg. More than 70 full-time and 100 part-time positions still must be filled there. There are a wide variety of positions available. All of them require a bachelor or master degree in mathematics, computer science, engineering, or physics. For a complete listing of the jobs and their requirements, click here. The average salary of the remaining jobs available is $96,500. Relocation assistance will be provided by the company. Crompton, Inc. is the country’s largest manufacturer of semiconductors. It has facilities in 22 states as well as in Australia, England, France, Russia, and Turkey. More information about Crompton, Inc. can be obtained here. To: Laurel Flannagan From: Fred Sweitzer Subject: Congratulations Date: January 11 Laurel, I was reading a list of the individuals who have been hired at the facility set to open in March. I was pleasantly surprised to see your name on it. It will be a pleasure to work with you once again. While I’ve spent the past five years in the San Diego office, I’ve been named the head of the R&D Department, so it looks like we’ll be seeing a lot of each other. I noticed on your application that you worked at Gerona, Inc. for three years. I’m sure you must have acquired some impressive skills there. Hopefully, you can put them to good use on a few of research projects we’re going to be involved in. I’m looking forward to seeing you again on the second of March. Sincerely, Fred Sweitzer
